hard_rules.name: Protect critical workloads
hard_rules.reason: Critical workloads marked protected cannot receive reductions.

hard_rules.name: Business event freeze
hard_rules.reason: Defer affected workloads during active events with freeze_optimization=true.

hard_rules.name: Recent critical incident cooldown
hard_rules.reason: Require review after a matching critical incident within 14 days.

hard_rules.name: Maximum single-step reduction
hard_rules.reason: No single resource reduction may exceed 25%.

hard_rules.name: Preserve limits
hard_rules.reason: CPU and memory limits must remain unchanged.

hard_rules.name: Critical replica floor
hard_rules.reason: Critical workloads must retain at least two replicas.
